title: We Await Muharram
body:
All the countries now are covered with darkness, darkness. May Allah protect you and protect your children,
and protect the nation of the Beloved from every evil and every illness, in this world and in the Next.
Blessings from the Seal of Prophets (s)! (...)
(In the past) did our mothers ever go to the doctor to deliver (her baby)? The midwife (came to the house).
When my mother, may Allah’s Mercy be upon her, began to have contractions (to deliver), they rushed to call
the midwife and she was quickly ushered from her house to ours, not to the hospital! I was already there
(born). Nobody touched me, not even the midwife, who said, “Where, where is she (my mother)?” She went
inside the room and saw me sitting there. SubhaanAllahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem. Now for every little thing
they want a doctor, for what? (...)
O my Lord! I need du`a, yaa Rabbee, yaa Allah! O our Lord! Make our matters easy. Open our hearts and
remove our worries. Destroy our enemies from humans and jinn. O my Lord! Amaan yaa Rabbee!
Problems do not end. The world is for the world, and therefore, I am looking for the month of Muharram
when, if something happens, this world will be like this. Kun fayakoon, “Be, and It is!” (36:82). Sayidina
Mahdi (a) will come and this year he was present on Arafat, but one day before, on Friday. This year was Hajj

al-Akbar. All awliyaullah were present there but they did not want the common people to know because the
manifestation was very powerful this year, and common people would not be able to carry it. First, it was
decided that the day of Arafat would be for the public on Friday, but at the last moment it was changed for
the day after, Saturday. They delayed it so they can gather there. This is the knowledge we have; beyond this
we don’t know. This is what we knew. SubhaanAllahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem.
The Prophet (s) informed us that there will be troubles and quarrelling among the Arabs. Now the Arabs are
divided and that came down upon them from Heavens. May Allah (swt) forgive us and protect us from His
Wrath. But these troubles (among Arabs) must end in Muharram, because Allah Almighty strengthens Islam
always in Muharram al-Haraam. We will see: if there is movement, everyone must stay where they are. They
should not come and go or move around, no! The tenth day of Muharram, if what was supposed to happen
happens, in Muharram and Safar al-khayr, millions will perish!
People became tyrants, who don’t listen to the words of Allah (swt) and they do not follow the words of the
Prophet (s), they just want to follow unbelief (kufr). What Allah (swt) revealed to His Beloved (s), He gave the
holy book, Divine Law.
••••• ••••• ••••••• ••••• ••••••• •••••• ••••••••••••• •••• •••••••••••••
Whosoever does not rule by what Allah revealed are unbelievers. (5:44)
Who goes after the unbelievers and likes to follow them will be struck by Allah’s (swt) severe punishment!
What happened in Egypt is from His severe punishment and the same happened in Libya, Yemen, Tunisia,
Algeria and in Syria! All that happened in the Muslim nations is so they may be saved and hold tightly to the
Divine Law. Whoever holds tight to Divine Law will be saved, and if they don’t hold on to Divine Law will be
taken away. Allahuma laa hawla wa laa quwwata illa billah!
Fatihah.
Lefke, 12.11.2011 (Translated from Arabic)
